rationale: Record an editor-open performance change that crosses these families' selectors. A materialized browser document handed to __pulpRuntimeImport__ is decoded and SHA-256 verified once per process; a later import with byte-identical input reuses the same immutable bundle, and rejected inputs are never kept. The accepted and rejected documents, and the bundle each accepted one yields, are unchanged. The QuickJS whole-script bytecode cache now also takes scripts from 2 KB, so a document's smaller inline scripts read bytecode on reopen. No importer lowering, DesignIR shape, capture path, renderer selection, asset format, fixture or threshold changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
tests: pulp-test-group-view-widgets WidgetBridge __pulpRuntimeImport__ verifies a document once per process
